name: kda_train_fwd_bwd_perchannel_safegate_h128
description: One KDA training step (forward + backward): packed varlen sequences, in-kernel q/k L2 norm, in-kernel beta sigmoid, per-channel A_log safe decay gate g = -5*sigmoid(exp(A_log)*(g_raw+dt_bias)), zero initial state, no final state. Outputs are the attention output and every input gradient for a given upstream gradient do.

total_tokens.description: Total packed tokens in the THD layout.

num_heads.description: KDA heads. q/k and v head counts are equal.

beta.description: Beta logits; sigmoid applied in kernel.

A_log.description: Per-channel decay scale (one value per head and key channel).

reference:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
import torch
from torch.utils.checkpoint import checkpoint

LOWER_BOUND = -5.0  # safe gate g_min
L2_EPS = 1e-6       # FLA l2norm eps
BLOCK = 256         # recurrence steps per checkpointed block (memory only)


def _block(S, q, k, v, a, b, starts):
    outs = []
    for t in range(q.shape[0]):
        if t in starts:  # first token of a packed document: state restarts at zero
            S = torch.zeros_like(S)
        S = S * a[t].exp()[..., None]
        kS = torch.einsum("hk,hkv->hv", k[t], S)
        S = S + torch.einsum("hk,hv->hkv", b[t][:, None] * k[t], v[t] - kS)
        outs.append(torch.einsum("hk,hkv->hv", q[t], S))
    return S, torch.stack(outs)


def run(q, k, v, g, beta, A_log, dt_bias, cu_seqlens, do):
    with torch.enable_grad():
        leaves = [x.detach().float().requires_grad_() for x in (q, k, v, g, beta, A_log, dt_bias)]
        qf, kf, vf, gf, bf, Af, df = leaves
        _, T, H, K = qf.shape
        qn = qf[0] * torch.rsqrt((qf[0] * qf[0]).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + L2_EPS) * K ** -0.5
        kn = kf[0] * torch.rsqrt((kf[0] * kf[0]).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + L2_EPS)
        # per-channel safe gate, log-space decay in [LOWER_BOUND, 0)
        a = LOWER_BOUND * torch.sigmoid(Af.exp().view(H, K) * (gf[0] + df.view(H, K)))
        b = torch.sigmoid(bf[0])
        starts_all = set(int(x) for x in cu_seqlens.tolist())
        S = qn.new_zeros(H, K, vf.shape[-1])
        outs = []
        for s in range(0, T, BLOCK):
            e = min(T, s + BLOCK)
            st = frozenset(t - s for t in range(s, e) if t in starts_all)
            S, o_blk = checkpoint(_block, S, qn[s:e], kn[s:e], vf[0, s:e], a[s:e], b[s:e], st,
                                  use_reentrant=False)
            outs.append(o_blk)
        o = torch.cat(outs)[None]
        grads = torch.autograd.grad(o, leaves, grad_outputs=do.float())
    dq, dk, dv, dg, dbeta, dA, ddt = grads
    bf16 = torch.bfloat16
    out = (o.to(bf16), dq.to(bf16), dk.to(bf16), dv.to(bf16), dg.to(bf16), dbeta.to(bf16),
            dA.float(), ddt.float())
    return tuple(t.detach() for t in out)
